selection.basis: Select the four highest-scoring exact candidate mainland-price gaps in the current evidence-found queue. Each has an official suggested price but still lacks an observed mainland checkout value; current exact seller/order routes may close the gap, while MSRP alone will not.

targets.exact_identity: Giant Revolt Advanced 2, current mainland complete-bike candidate
Giant Propel Advanced SL 1 (Gen 4), mainland complete-bike candidate
Giant Defy Advanced 2, current mainland complete-bike candidate
Merida REACTO 6000 CN 27 (CF3), current mainland complete-bike candidate

research_rules.source_priority: For each candidate, verify the exact current mainland manufacturer or authorized seller SKU/order page before any secondary source.
research_rules.price_acceptance: Record a checkout/listing observation only when the exact model/build and CNY amount are directly visible from the source. An official suggested-retail price alone does not close a missing observed-checkout gap; do not infer size/color availability, discounts, shipping, or checkout totals.
research_rules.recording: Add dated source provenance and a dated candidate observation when directly supported. Preserve existing MSRP separately from transaction/listing observations.
research_rules.stop_criteria: Process the four models sequentially. Stop on exact current price evidence or a concrete access/identity/option limitation. Preserve all unknowns; do not use login, CAPTCHA handling, or bypass routes.
